# ShiftLeftCyber

> ShiftLeftCyber builds SecureSBOM, a platform for signing and verifying Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) and artifact-bound SBOM attestations. It provides managed signing keys, CycloneDX, SPDX and AI-BOM support, online and offline verification, and APIs and CI/CD integrations.

## SecureSBOM

- [SecureSBOM](https://shiftleftcyber.io/securesbom/): SBOM signing and verification platform for software supply chain security.
- [SBOM Attestations: How to Sign and Verify](https://shiftleftcyber.io/attestations/): Plain-language reference for the attestation sign and verify APIs, with field-by-field explanations, checklists, error codes, and an in-browser verification demo.
- [SLSA and SecureSBOM](https://shiftleftcyber.io/securesbom/slsa-and-securesbom/): How build provenance and SBOM signing complement each other.
- [Sigstore comparison](https://shiftleftcyber.io/securesbom/sigstore-comparison/): How SecureSBOM differs from Sigstore for SBOM signing.
- [FAQ](https://shiftleftcyber.io/faq/): Common questions about SBOM signing, attestations, verification, and threat models.

## Blog

- [Introducing Attestation Signing](https://shiftleftcyber.io/blog/2026-10-19-bind-the-sbom-to-the-artifact/): Why an SBOM must be bound to the artifact it describes.
